description: Read the ordered turns of the most recent conversation between the agent and one customer. Each turn carries its turn_id, conversation_id and the observed steps - LLM calls with a preview of the model output, and tool calls with the tool name, input and output - plus latency and status where available. Use it to see why the agent answered the way it did. Malformed records, and tool responses that cannot be matched to a tool call, may be missing. This list is CURSOR-PAGINATED: it returns {data, paging} - page with the `after` cursor from paging.cursors, and stop when paging carries no `next` link, because a page can be empty and still have more after it.

after.description: Cursor - return the page immediately after it.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

before.description: Cursor - return the page immediately before it.

end_timestamp_ms.description: Only turns that started at or before this Unix time in milliseconds.

limit.description: Maximum entries per page. A page can be shorter.

start_timestamp_ms.description: Only turns that started at or after this Unix time in milliseconds.

user_phone_number.description: The customer: a phone number in digits only with the country code (15551234567, no + or separators), a Business-Scoped User ID such as US.2788620304833812, or the conversation_id returned by test_agent. Prefer the BSUID for a customer who has ever used a WhatsApp username - their phone number may be unknown, which returns Consumer not found.

name: mba_get_conversation_turns
title: Read conversation turns
